findingDetails.title: Sixteen scan sites each restate the rule, and nothing detects one that omits it
findingDetails.claim: Eight name-only skips and eight trust-checked scans each restate the local-* rule; only the containment half is shared and no check detects a scan that omits the rule.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Looked for a shared name predicate or a repo check that enumerates scan sites; found neither, and the inventory is prose in a phase document.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Splitting skip from trust-check is deliberate because a tracked writer must skip unconditionally while a local scan must trust-check; only the identical name test repeats.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a test or lint that enumerates scan sites and asserts each states a rule

findingDetails.title: The two root inventories are hand-maintained and the reason they differ is not recorded at the guard
findingDetails.claim: Four ignore rules, eight guard roots and eight hardcoded harness roots must be kept consistent by hand, and the guard does not say why only four roots need ignore rules.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether one list derives from the other; both are literals.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The difference is intentional and documented one file away, and the harness covers all eight roots so a missed root fails a test rather than escaping silently.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a generated root list or a comment at the guard naming the four-rule rationale

findingDetails.title: Evidence durability is uneven, and the two contested phases are the ones with no durable proof
findingDetails.claim: Phase 005 keeps 15 tracked evidence files; phases 001 and 002 keep only .gitkeep and cite worker reports that are not in the tree; phase 003 scratch is empty.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the cited worker reports live elsewhere in the packet; they do not.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Each phase chose its own evidence practice and the packet set no standard; the consequence is that the contested phases cannot be re-read.

results.notes: Rule implemented everywhere claimed; duplication is the cost.
Evidence tracked for phase 005; phases 002 and 003 rely on references and a temp path.
